Apprehending the Arcane Form.effect: See active magic, curses, and enchanted items as auras (1-sentence read); also see in total darkness.

Cognitive Supersession of the Inferior O.effect: Telepathically bond with and command one visible normal animal, sharing its senses. It obeys non-suicidal orders but won't fight.

The Coruscating Coffin.effect: One visible creature within 100'/level takes 1d8/level, Physical save for half. 1-HD NPC foes die outright. Ignores non-magical cover.

Damnation of the Sense.effect: Seize control of one sense of a visible creature (blind, deafen, feed false impressions). Mental save; failure = whole scene, success = 1 round.

Decree of Ligneous Dissolution.effect: Annihilate all non-magical plant/fungus matter (wood, rope, cloth) in up to 1 cube/level. Plant-monsters take 1d10/level, Physical save for half.

The Excellent Transpicuous Transformatio.effect: Turn up to one willing target/level invisible. Breaks for all if any subject runs, attacks, or casts.

Imperceptible Cerebral Divulgence.effect: Read a visible creature's surface thoughts and query its memories (1 question/level; each risks ending it on a Mental save). Cast subtly, no gestures.

Ineluctable Shackles of Volition.effect: Enthrall a visible creature's will (Mental save at -Magic). It obeys non-suicidal physical commands but appears dazed; recasting frees prior thralls.

The Long Amber Moment.effect: On Turn: put a touched willing/helpless creature into invulnerable temporal stasis, immune to non-magical harm.

Phantasmal Mimesis.effect: Create a self-acting multi-sensory illusion in up to 1 cube/level. Illusory attackers hit with caster's bonus for 1d8, vanish if struck; disbelief allows a Mental save.

Velocitous Imbuement.effect: On Turn: up to one willing target/level doubles ground move, can run on walls/ceilings and leave melee freely. +1 System Strain to users.

Wardpact Invocation.effect: Either make a creature partly weapon-immune (hits need a Physical save to land, 1 round/2 levels) OR render one visible weapon harmless for the scene.

The Wind of the Final Repose.effect: Living creatures of 4 HD or fewer in a 20' radius fall asleep; roused by damage or a Main Action, else wake at scene's end.

Calculation of the Evoked Servitor.effect: Summon an intelligent familiar (1 HP/level, AC 14, no attack) that obeys any order, even suicidal, and shares a telepathic bond. Can be re-summoned if slain.

Casting Forth the Inner Eye.effect: Scry a distant location through a reflective/luminous surface (within 100'/level or a place you've been). Warded sites are immune; can't repeat a site within a week.

Conjunction of the Inexorable Step.effect: Teleport a visible creature or loose object (<= horse) within 100' to a visible safe spot within a half-mile. Unwilling targets get a Mental save (success swaps the caster instead).

Decree of Lithic Dissolution.effect: Reduce all non-magical stone/earth/mineral in up to 1 cube/level to dust (metal unaffected); may collapse structures. Rock-monsters take 1d10/level, save for half.

Extirpate Arcana.effect: Dispel unwanted magic in a 20' radius. Auto-negates effects from equal/lower-HD casters; else a contested Magic check (higher level +2). Standing magics only suppressed 1d6 rounds.

The Inexorable Imputation.effect: Make a one-sentence statement; all who hear within 40' must Mental save or believe it (unless impossible or abhorrent). Exempt 2 allies/level.

Jade Palanquin of the Faceless God.effect: Conjure a floating 12'x8' stone palanquin that bears up to 2,000 lb at shoulder height; pulled by one bearer.

Mantle of Disjecting Dissection.effect: A willing creature is wreathed in blade-shards; anyone touching/meleeing them makes an Evasion save or takes 1d6+level first. Indiscriminate (hits allies too).

Prudentially Transient Abnegation of Lif.effect: Instant: a target dropped to 0 HP appears gorily dead to all examination, then revives within 2 hours at 2 HP/level (+2 Strain). Destroyed remains can't revive.

Resounding Temporal Echo.effect: Up to one ally/level gains an extra Main Action (not for casting) for 1d4+1 rounds; +1 System Strain per round the bonus is used.

The Verdant Vallation.effect: Grow a 20'-high, 3'-thick wall of vines up to 20'/level wide; 5 HP/level to cut through, optional thorns deal 2d6 to climbers. Persists if rooted in good earth.

Visitation of the Clement Clime.effect: Caster and up to 3 allies/level become immune to mundane heat/cold/acid/electricity; half (or no) damage from magical versions.

Adopt the Simulacular Visage.effect: Transform up to one willing target/level into a perfect simulacrum of any humanoid seen (voice, scent, clothing, language). No special abilities granted.

Conjunct the Vital Viscera.effect: Render up to one subject/level plastic: transfer HP, poisons, diseases, or body parts between willing/bound creatures; a willing target can be absorbed into another.

Exhalation of Congelating Cold.effect: Freeze a radius of 10'/level; living creatures take 1d6/2 levels (Physical save half), liquids freeze 2' deep. Failed save = lose Move action 1d4 rounds.

Foresightful Apprehension.effect: Describe an intended action; the GM tells you the most likely outcome within the next 5 minutes. Once/week per general topic.

The Glass Chimes of the Bamboo Terrace.effect: Summon floating chimes for subtle long-distance messaging (10 miles/level), audible only to chosen targets; shatter them as a Main Action to deal 3d6 in 40'.

The Howl of Light.effect: Detonate a 20' radius blast at a point within 50'/level for 1d8/level (Evasion save half); channels down narrow passages for extra 1d6x10'.

Phobic Storm.effect: Enemies within 40' make a Morale check at -1 or flee; those who hold take 1 damage/level. No effect on the fearless or Morale-12 foes.

Scorn the Fetters of Earth.effect: Caster and up to one ally/level can walk/run through the air in three dimensions; or force one flyer/level to land (Physical save at -Magic).

The Torment of Tumefaction.effect: Curse a visible creature with boils and tumors; vigorous action (not moving) costs 2 dmg/level/round. Main-action Physical save to end; weaker foes are cursed indefinitely.

Touch of Elucidating Intangibility.effect: Touch a non-magical barrier: see/hear through a 10' cube of it, or make it intangible 1 round/level. Anyone caught when it re-solidifies takes 2d10 and is ejected.

Vallation of Specified Exclusion.effect: Draw a line (<=20'/level) that bars a describable kind of target (e.g. 'humans') and their powers, as a wall 100' up. Shatters if the warded are attacked across it.

Calculation of the Phantasmal Eidolon.effect: Summon an ox-sized obedient combatant (4 HD, 20 HP, AC 15, +6/1d8 Shock 2/AC15) that fights to the death. Its damage only knocks out (1 HP after an hour). Pick one quality (fly/mimic/telepathy/use gear).

Contingent Excision of Arcana.effect: Set a trigger to later dispel magic (as Extirpate Arcana) as an Instant action once. Ends when used.

Disjunctive Temporal Reversion.effect: Instant: one creature within 100' replays its current round's actions as if they never happened. Unwilling targets get a Mental save.

Evert the Inwardness.effect: Extract a container's contents into your hands; OR tear out a creature's innards — equal/lower-HD targets save or die, all take 1d10/level (Physical save half).

The Grinding Geas.effect: Bind a visible creature to a one-sentence command (not suicidal/impossible). Defiance brings a wasting disease that kills in 1d6 weeks; complying reverses it. Mental save if able to resist.

Obnubilation of the Will.effect: A helpless/restrained creature makes a Mental save or becomes an intelligent, initiative-using slave (suicidal acts need another save). Cap = 2x level thralls; obvious tics give it away.

Ochre Sigil of Juxtaposition.effect: Cast in two parts within a mile (one slot): inscribe a sigil, then swap everything within 10' of you with everything within 10' of the sigil. Weak unwilling targets get no save.

Pierce the Pallid Gate.effect: Open a cart-sized rift between two known points within 100'/level (>=20' apart) to see and pass through. Closable as an Instant action.

Sigil of Aeolian Auctoritas.effect: Conjure a 100'x30' gust (Physical save or bowled back 30' for 1d6 and lose next Main); or outdoors, control local weather for 1 hour/level.

Abdication of Temporal Presence.effect: Caster and up to one ally/level step outside time for 1d4+1 free rounds while the world freezes; they can't affect outside objects or those still in time.

Banishment to the Black Glass Labyrinth.effect: Exile all but the caster in a 10' radius (within 300') into an infinite obsidian maze. Mental save to return next round; <=5-HD victims get no save and are trapped until the caster dies.

The Dazzling Prismatic Hemicycle.effect: A 100' cone forces a Physical save; failures roll 1d6 for a random gruesome fate (dust, sleep, insanity, petrification, or enthrallment).

Deluge of Hell.effect: Rain ruin on a 200'/level radius (within 3,000') for 1d8/level (Physical save half); 4-HD-or-less targets die. Outdoors only; caster saves or takes a quarter of the damage.

The Earth as Clay.effect: Over an hour, mold natural stone/earth within 300'/level — raise hills, dig tunnels, form simple buildings. Can't work earth shaped by intelligent hands within 1,000'.

Invocation of the Invincible Citadel.effect: Instant: raise a 20'-radius force bubble around the caster, impervious to attacks, magic, and matter from either side. Those inside may leave but not return.

Open the High Road.effect: Open a one-way gate from the caster to a prepared point within 100 miles/level (1-hour attunement). Cart-sized, 1 minute/level. 1-in-10 chance to misfire 1d100 miles off.

Elemental Resilience.effect: Unharmed by mundane cold or sub-furnace heat; half damage from magical/intense flame or frost. (Granted at 1st level.)

Elemental Sparks.effect: Conjure petty flame, water, ice, stone, or wind for minor tricks. Can't meaningfully solve a problem more than once/session. (Granted at 1st level.)

Beckoned Deluge.effect: Conjure water drenching 1 cube/level within 50'/level — ruins bowstrings, douses fire, deals 1d6/level to fiery supernatural creatures. Persists; hydrates ten/level.

Earthsight.effect: See solid object outlines in total darkness and peer through earth/stone up to your level in feet.

Elemental Blast.effect: Hurl an elemental bolt at a target within 50'/level (Magic + Int/Cha/Dex + level to hit, no melee penalty) for 1d6 + level + attribute.

Flamesight.effect: See thermal gradients (and living creatures) in total darkness; optionally make your eyes shed 30' of light.

Pavis of Elements.effect: Conjure an elemental barrier granting +4 AC (stacking, but never above AC 18) while Committed.

Petrifying Stare.effect: A visible creature makes a Physical save or is partly petrified, losing its Move action for half your level (round up). Flyers land, swimmers sink.

Rune of Destruction.effect: Lay a trap-rune on an adjacent surface (1 hour/level); anyone coming within 2' triggers a 5' elemental blast for 2d6 + level.

Steps of Air.effect: A visible ally flies at normal Move for 1 round/level; or use Instantly to negate one target's falling damage.

Stunning Shock.effect: A metal-wearing or wet creature within 50'/level loses its next Main action (Physical save downgrades to losing its Move). Once/scene per target.

Thermal Shield.effect: Negate one instance of fire or frost damage to a visible ally or object.

Aqueous Harmony.effect: Caster and up to a dozen allies gain water-breathing, pressure/cold tolerance, clear underwater sight, and unhindered movement and attacks underwater.

Flame Scrying.effect: Sense all open flames within 30'/level and scry through one chosen flame, seeing and hearing around it while you stay focused.

Elemental Favor.effect: Appeal to a <=10' cube of earth, stone, water, flame, or air; it reshapes/moves as asked, holding the new form until scene's end (or permanently if stable).

Elemental Spy.effect: Enchant a stone, bit of liquid, flame, or smoke; for 1 day/level, see and hear around the object as a Main action while it survives.

Boreal Wings.effect: A visible ally within 100' flies at twice their Move; descends gently if it ends aloft. Lasts a scene (longer at higher levels).

The Burrower Below.effect: Carve a stabilizable tunnel through natural stone/earth up to 20'/level long, 10' across (only 2'/level through worked stone).

Flame Without End.effect: Make a flame (<= caster's size) eternal and non-consuming; resists all but burial/immersion. As a weapon it adds +2 damage. One free per level.

Pact of Stone and Sea.effect: Pick earth/water/fire/wind; a visible target is immune to that element's mundane harm and secondary effects (e.g. fire-pacted can't be boiled) for the scene.

Elemental Vallation.effect: Raise a 10'/level wall of earth (20 HP), fire (3d6+level passing through), water (2d6 + ejection), or air (1d6+level electric, invisible).

Like the Stones.effect: Take on an element's qualities for the scene: stone (stabilize, ignore 3 dmg), water (squeeze through gaps), air (fly, +4 AC vs ranged), or fire (1d6 to melee foes, heat-immune).

Wind Walking.effect: A target and their gear become an insubstantial mist, harmable only by cloud-disrupting forces; they move freely in 3D but can't manipulate objects.

Calcifying Scourge.effect: A visible target within 100' makes a Physical save or is turned to stone until the caster undoes it (success = lose Move action 1d6 rounds). Damage while petrified carries over.

Elemental Guardian.effect: Animate a human-sized mass of an element as a loyal 4-HD guardian (AC 15, +6/1d10) with element-based perks (earth = 6 HD, fire = Shock, water = AC 18, air = flight). One at a time.

Fury of the Elements.effect: Erupt molten rock and steam on a point within 200'/level for 10d6 in 30', then the zone wanders 1d6x10' randomly each round for 1d6 rounds. Molten remnants linger all day.

Tremors of the Depths.effect: Call up an earthquake over a 500' radius that topples unreinforced structures, tunnels, and caves. Builds over 5 minutes; negated only if dispelled within a minute.

Healing Touch.effect: For the scene, heal a touched ally 2d6 + Heal skill as a Main action (+1 System Strain to the target each time). (Granted at 1st level.)

Empowered Healer.effect: Your Healing Touch also adds your level to the healing done.

Facile Healer.effect: Your Healing Touch no longer requires you to Commit Effort to activate it.

Far Healer.effect: Your Healing Touch can reach a visible target within 10'/level.

Final Repose.effect: A visible creature takes a Physical-save penalty equal to your Heal skill for the scene; if dropped to 0 HP they die outright with no stabilization or revival.

Healer's Eye.effect: While Committed, use a Main action to diagnose diseases/poisons, read physiology and current HP; also see living creatures regardless of light.

Limb Restoration.effect: (8th level+) Commit all remaining Effort to regrow a touched target's missing limb/organ or efface a debility; their System Strain is maxed.

Purge Ailment.effect: Cure one poison or disease in a touched ally (revives poison-deaths within 6 minutes). Magical ailments may need a Heal check vs 8+. 7th level: only Scene effort.

Refined Restoration.effect: You and up to a dozen allies you tend before sleep lose 2 System Strain from a night's rest instead of 1.

Revive the Fallen.effect: (8th level+) Revive a touched creature dead within 1 minute/level (not dismembered/incinerated). Strain is maxed; they wake after 24 hours at 1 HP.

Swift Healer.effect: Your Healing Touch can be used as an On Turn action once/day per level (not twice/round on one target).

The Healer's Knife.effect: Your Healing Touch can instead deal its healing amount as damage to a living target (you take 1 System Strain). Melee use needs a Punch attack (hit bonus = Heal).

Tireless Vigor.effect: While Committed, your need to eat/drink/breathe/sleep does not worsen and you regenerate 1 lost HP per hour.

Vital Furnace.effect: Negate the damage from a non-mortal injury you just took. Also: you auto-stabilize at 0 HP and wake in 10 minutes at 1 HP.

Bonetalker.effect: See and speak with any undead; Commit Effort to read a visible undead's surface thoughts and orders. Mindless undead won't attack you unless commanded.

Cold Flesh.effect: No sleep needed, abstract pain only, take at most 2 damage from any Shock, and gain natural AC 12 + half level (round down).

Consume Life Energy.effect: With a Punch or a consecrated melee weapon, heal 1d6 per hit (up to the damage dealt, never above the target's remaining HP).

False Death.effect: While Committed you appear dead to mundane examination (lose Main actions but move and perceive; no bodily needs; poisons/diseases pause). Up to 1 day/level.

Gravesight.effect: While Committed, see living creatures' life energies (and their sicknesses/poisons) as glowing patterns, and see normally in total darkness.

Keeper of the Gate.effect: At will, Mortally Wounded creatures within 20'/level die unrevivably; or Commit Effort to auto-stabilize any/all within range (+1 Strain each).

Life Bridge.effect: For the scene, shift HP between two willing/helpless creatures (>= dog-sized) you touch — even enough to Mortally Wound the donor, but not past the recipient's max.

Master of Bones.effect: Undead roll saves vs your powers twice, worse result; Commit Effort to negate one attack/power/spell from an undead (unless it has 2x your levels in HD).

Red Harvest.effect: When an intelligent 1+ HD creature dies within 50', heal 1d6 + level OR gain +4 on your next hit roll this scene. Once/round, no stacking.

Unaging.effect: You no longer naturally age (hale to species max +20%/level) and become immune to poisons and diseases.

Uncanny Ichor.effect: Predators won't bite you. Puncture/stab wounds can Mortally Wound but not kill you unless you're utterly pincushioned or catastrophically maimed.

Unliving Persistence.effect: Auto-stabilize when Mortally Wounded; can be used on a touched ally instead. Won't save the dismembered or finally-slain.

Command the Dead.effect: Bind up to 2x level HD of visible undead within 100' (Mental save at -Magic); the fully-bound become suicidally loyal. Cap of 2x level HD held at once.

Query the Skull.effect: A corpse dead no more than 1 day/level answers 1 truthful question/level, tersely and literally. Once per corpse.

Smite the Dead.effect: Blast a 20' radius within 100'/level; hostile undead take 1d10/level and those of <= your level in HD save or are destroyed. May Commit Effort to make it free of a slot.

Terrible Liveliness.effect: Give an undead the tangible semblance of a healthy living being at any age, able to do all activities its cognition allows. One disguise/level; not on unwilling sentients.

Augment Mortal Vitality.effect: A willing target gains a Physical-save bonus equal to your Magic skill and auto-stabilizes when Mortally Wounded; once/scene heal a non-mortal injury. +1 Strain.

Enfeebling Wave.effect: Living creatures in a 20' radius (within 100') save or, for the scene, halve their Move and roll attacks/damage twice taking the worse (success = next turn only).

Final Death.effect: Curse one target/level: for the scene they can't regain HP and die instantly if Mortally Wounded. A Physical save after each failed healing ends it.

Raise Corpse.effect: Animate a skeleton/corpse as a loyal 1-HD servant (AC 13, +1/1d6) with a human degree of intelligence but only vague memories. Active count <= caster level.

Compel Flesh.effect: A living creature or bodied undead within 100' is paralyzed unless you command it each turn (On Turn). Physical save each turn to break free, taking 1 dmg/level per attempt.

Festering Curse.effect: Force a corpse's qualities on a living target: food tastes of ash, no physical pleasure, -2 social checks. No injury, just misery, until lifted. Stronger foes save.

Forgetting the Grave.effect: A willing target cannot die for 1 round/level; at 0 HP they lose their Move but act on (further damage forces Physical saves). At the end, 0-HP targets are Mortally Wounded.

Merge Souls.effect: Bond two touched willing/helpless creatures to pool HP and communicate telepathically; neither dies until the pool hits 0 (then both Mortally Wounded). Ends at daybreak.

Boneshaper.effect: Reshape a willing/helpless living or undead body over an hour — add/remove limbs, recolor, retexture. Can shift a Cha/physical modifier +1/-1 (max +2/-2). Imitation: Dex/Magic vs 10.

Raise Grave Knight.effect: Raise a 4+ HD corpse as a strong, fully intelligent, loyal undead knight (4 HD, AC 15, +6/1d10) that recalls its life and regains all HP at dusk. One at a time.

Call of the Tomb.effect: Enemies within 40' save or, for 1 round/level (success = 1 round), are auto-hit by all attacks with maximized damage dice and lose all special damage defenses.

Everlasting.effect: Instant: for 5 rounds no allied creature within 50' can drop below 1 HP. At the end, the caster is left at 1 HP. Once/day per creature.

Martial Style.effect: Your hit die is at least 1d6/level and your Punch hit bonus is at least an Expert's. At 3rd level, Punch attacks count as magic weapons. (Granted at 1st level.)

Unarmed Might.effect: Your unarmed damage rises by level (per the Vowed table), and you add Punch skill to it. (Granted at 1st level.)

Unarmored Defense.effect: Unarmored and shieldless, your base Armor Class is 13 + half your level (round down). (Granted at 1st level.)

Brutal Counter.effect: After an enemy's melee attack on you (hit or miss), make a free physical attack or one-Main-action offensive ability against them. Usable during Total Defense.

Faultless Awareness.effect: You cannot be surprised and wake from deep sleep in time to respond to imminent peril.

Hurling Throw.effect: After a successful attack, the target (<= ox-sized) saves or is thrown up to 10', falls prone, and takes your attack's damage. Once/round per target.

The Inward Eye.effect: While Committed, you sense your surroundings like normal sight regardless of darkness, mist, or blindness.

Leap of the Heavens.effect: Leap up to your full Move horizontally (half vertically); or use Instantly to negate falling damage from any height.

Master's Vigor.effect: You keep youthful vigor for your full lifespan and regain 2 lost HP per hour naturally.

Mob Justice.effect: For the scene, foes can't Swarm-attack you, and you're immune to Shock while meleeing 2+ foes. Using it disrupts your spellcasting that round.

Nimble Ascent.effect: For the scene, move up vertical/overhanging surfaces and difficult terrain at full Move with no slipping (needs one free hand, not on glass/enchanted surfaces).

Purified Body.effect: Cure any disease or poison on you, or negate your need for sleep/food/water/air for 24 hours.

Revivifying Breath.effect: Heal yourself 1d6 + level with no Strain (usable even at 0 HP, but then Commits all remaining Effort). Once/scene.

Shattering Strike.effect: After a round of stillness, shatter a wooden barrier (1'/level deep; stone at 4th, metal at 7th). Against an immobilized creature, the blow does 1d12/level.

Style Weaponry.effect: Pick three weapon classes; use Punch for their hit rolls (no Punch damage bonus, but Martial Style applies).

Unobtrusive Step.effect: Once/scene, reroll a failed Sneak check or an impersonation check.

Change Form.effect: Commit Effort for the day to transform into a mastered alternate form until you die, shift again, or end it (On Turn); HP/Strain/scores carry over, base attack bonus is at least the form's Form Bonus, and a quadruped's Move is +10'. (L1 free art.)
Change Form.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L138

Eyes of the Hawk.effect: This form has acute senses: scent trails, hear faint noises, identify faces at 1,000', see in all but total darkness; +2 to sensory Notice checks.
Eyes of the Hawk.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L142

Feline Leap.effect: As a Move action, jump your full Move horizontally (or half vertically); subtract your Move from fall distance for fall damage.
Feline Leap.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L144

Feral Prowess.effect: Pick Str/Dex/Con for this form; +1 to that modifier (max +2). Obvious alteration (can't pass as human); Con-gained HP lost on shifting back.
Feral Prowess.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L146

Intrinsic Armor.effect: This form has natural armor: base AC 14 + half level (round down), modifiable by Dex and a shield if the form can hold one.
Intrinsic Armor.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L148

Manifest Wings.effect: This form grows wings; can't attack while staying aloft, but fly at Move +10'/action, up to 10 miles/hour and 5 hours/day overland.
Manifest Wings.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L150

Octopus' Embrace.effect: This form has 4+ usable limbs; hold up to four Stowed objects Ready free of Readied Encumbrance. No extra attacks/shields/focus-actions.
Octopus' Embrace.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L152

Perfect Mimicry.effect: This form can exactly duplicate a specific creature given hair, a fresh blood drop, or 10 minutes' close observation; no further samples once learned.
Perfect Mimicry.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L154

Pliant Flesh.effect: Change Form becomes usable On Turn (1/round) or as a 1-minute Effort-free shift; spending Effort to shift heals 1d6 + level. Intrinsic (free of form art limits).
Pliant Flesh.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L156

Savage Talons.effect: Natural weapons 1d8 (Str/Dex, Punch, Shock 2/AC 13) that harm creatures immune to non-magical weapons; +1 dmg/Shock at L3, +2 at L6, +3 at L9.
Savage Talons.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L158

Sculptor's Beauty.effect: This form improves Charisma modifier by +1 (max +2) via uncanny beauty; always something alien, so it can't pass as wholly normal.
Sculptor's Beauty.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L160

Serpent's Kiss.effect: On a hit, Commit Effort for the scene (Instant) for an extra 1d8 + Survive; optionally paralytic, leaving foes dropped to 0 HP helpless an hour instead of mortally wounded.
Serpent's Kiss.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L162

The Monkey's Road.effect: This form climbs sheer (non-glassy) surfaces at normal Move with three limbs free; halts a fall without damage if a graspable surface is within 10'.
The Monkey's Road.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L164

Warform.effect: +2 to all melee hit rolls in this form, usable even in a humanoid body; blatantly martial (can't pass as harmless).
Warform.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L166

Wisdom of Fin and Scale.effect: This form breathes water, swims at double Move, ignores cold/pressure, sees 60' underwater without light.
Wisdom of Fin and Scale.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L168

Favored Weapon.effect: Choose one non-unarmed melee weapon type; use the Duelist Favored-Weapon hit-bonus column (or =level if your other class is Partial Warrior). Not for thrown weapons. (L1 free art.)
Favored Weapon.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L224

Blood for Blood.effect: Commit Effort (Instant) when an enemy lands a physical hit on you; if you strike that foe with your favored weapon before next round ends, the blow hits automatically for no less than the damage dealt to you (up to weapon max).
Blood for Blood.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L228

Burst of Speed.effect: Commit Effort for the day (On Turn) to move your full Move as an On Turn action; once per round.
Burst of Speed.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L230

Code Duello.effect: Commit Effort for the day (On Turn) against one foe; while no one else attacks you/your target and you attack only it, gain +4 AC and roll hit rolls twice, better result. Disrupted = can't reinvoke that scene.
Code Duello.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L232

Crushing Superiority.effect: Favored weapon gains Less Lethal; Commit Effort (Instant) on a hit to force an Instinct check. Once/scene per target.
Crushing Superiority.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L234

Dauntless Step.effect: Commit Effort for the scene (On Turn); your Move this round may cross vertical surfaces/difficult terrain at full Move if you end upright on a weight-bearing surface.
Dauntless Step.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L236

Dodge Doom.effect: Commit Effort for the day (Instant) when caught in a blast; take half damage (none if it allows a save you pass) and move up to 10' to cover or away from the origin.
Dodge Doom.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L238

Forced Engagement.effect: Commit Effort (Instant) when attacking with your favored weapon to ignore one foe's Screen Ally for that attack.
Forced Engagement.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L240

Gentleman's Withdrawal.effect: Commit Effort (Move) to move your full rate unhindered by armed foes (unless they fully block you), as a Fighting Withdrawal against all engaged enemies.
Gentleman's Withdrawal.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L242

Graceful Leap.effect: Commit Effort (On Turn) to leap up to 10' as a Fighting Withdrawal; once/round, not after attacking. Immune to falling damage under 30'.
Graceful Leap.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L244

Lightning Draw.effect: Commit Effort for the day (Instant) at the start of hostilities; win initiative vs anyone lacking a like ability and ready a Stowed favored weapon Instantly.
Lightning Draw.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L246

Piercing Strike.effect: Commit Effort (On Turn) to mark a visible target; for the scene its AC counts as 10 vs your favored weapon's Shock.
Piercing Strike.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L248

Spiritual Weapon.effect: After translating a favored weapon to a spiritual template (destroying the physical form), Commit Effort (Instant) to manifest a Readied ghostly copy until released; dual-wielders summon two with one use.
Spiritual Weapon.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L250

Unbindable.effect: Commit Effort for the day (On Turn) to wriggle free of mundane bindings and gain an Evasion save to end a magical physical binding; once/round.
Unbindable.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L252

Unworthy Rabble.effect: Commit Effort for the day (On Turn); for the scene, reroll failed favored-weapon hit rolls vs 1-HD foes (2-HD at L8).
Unworthy Rabble.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L254

Whirling Evasion.effect: Base AC becomes 13 + half level (round up), modifiable by small shields and Dex but not armor or large shields.
Whirling Evasion.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L256

Bind Companion.effect: With a day's work, find and bind an animal companion (Wis/Survive vs 10+ for rare beasts); one met on adventure is bound as a Main Action (it gets a Mental save to resist and become immune). Release as a Main Action. (L1 free art.)
Bind Companion.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L310

Beast Ward.effect: Commit Effort (On Turn); while Committed, unintelligent beasts won't attack you unless commanded, starving, or provoked. Broken = no reactivation that scene; magical/trained beasts get a Mental save.
Beast Ward.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L314

Eyes of the Beast.effect: Commit Effort for the scene (On Turn) to share your companion's senses; neither of you can be surprised unless both are.
Eyes of the Beast.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L316

Feral Toughness.effect: Max HP +companion's natural HD; ignore outdoor heat/cold extremes; base AC 13 + half level (round up), modifiable by shields/Dex but not armor.
Feral Toughness.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L318

Howl of Distant Summons.effect: Commit Effort for the day (Main) to call a former companion to reach you within five minutes; a dangerous/long trip needs Cha/Survive vs 10+, failure means no recall for a week.
Howl of Distant Summons.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L320

Know the Weak Spot.effect: Roll damage twice (take higher) when harming a beast; optionally Commit Effort (Instant) to let an ally who hits a beast roll damage twice too.
Know the Weak Spot.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L322

Mind Call.effect: Commit Effort for the scene (On Turn) to forge a telepathic bond with your companion, giving orders and receiving info within its intellect.
Mind Call.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L324

Natural Weaponry.effect: Unarmed attacks count as weapons (Str/Dex, Punch/Stab) doing 1d8, Shock 2/AC 13, harming creatures immune to non-magical weapons; +1 dmg/Shock at L3, +2 at L6, +3 at L9.
Natural Weaponry.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L326

Savage Senses.effect: Commit Effort for the scene (On Turn); see in pitch dark, scent trails/belongings like a wolf, +2 to sight/sound/smell Notice checks.
Savage Senses.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L328

Shared Vitality.effect: Bound companions have HD no lower than your level (hit bonus >= half HD); Commit Effort (Instant) to stabilize a Mortally Wounded companion.
Shared Vitality.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L330

Swift Healing.effect: Commit Effort for the day (Main) to heal a companion 1d6 per character level; once per scene/fifteen minutes.
Swift Healing.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L332

Tongue of the Beasts.effect: Commit Effort (On Turn); while Committed, speak with any furred/feathered/scaled/skinned animal, granting it temporary humanlike intellect to converse (desires unchanged).
Tongue of the Beasts.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L334

A Thousand Tongues.effect: Commit Effort (On Turn); while Committed, speak with and understand any sentient with a language, seeming fluent while you speak your own tongue. No reading/writing of unknown scripts.
A Thousand Tongues.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L386

Armor of God.effect: Commit Effort (On Turn); while Committed, natural AC 15 + half level (round down), modifiable by shields/Dex but not worn armor.
Armor of God.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L388

Divine Guidance.effect: Commit Effort for the day (Main) to meditate on a choice; GM states weal/woe/mixed/nothing, looking ~an hour ahead.
Divine Guidance.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L390

Fear No Flame.effect: Commit Effort for the day (On Turn) on a target; for the scene immune to non-magical flame/smoke/explosive damage and reduce magical fire by 5 per Pray level.
Fear No Flame.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L392

God Wills It.effect: Commit Effort for the day (Instant); for the scene up to six allies/level in earshot gain Morale 12 and +1 hit & damage (incl. Shock); +2 at L5, +3 at L10.
God Wills It.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L394

Merciful Healing.effect: Commit Effort for the day (Main) and touch a target for 1d6+2 healing (2d6+4 at L4, 4d6+8 at L8); reviving the Mortally Wounded or healing in combat adds 1 Strain.
Merciful Healing.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L396

Sanctified Ward.effect: Commit Effort (On Turn); while maintained and until you act hostilely, immune to Shock, +4 AC and +4 saves, and foes need an Instinct check to target you. Ended = no reactivation that scene; healing isn't hostile.
Sanctified Ward.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L398

Smite the Wicked.effect: Commit Effort for the day (On Turn) attacking one target: +4 to hit, inflict your level as automatic damage, and roll damage dice twice (take higher). Once/scene per target.
Smite the Wicked.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L400

The Light of Faith.effect: Commit Effort (On Turn); while Committed, cast bright radiance up to 30', optionally visible only to you and up to a dozen allies.
The Light of Faith.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L402

Transubstantiation.effect: Commit Effort for the day (Main) to turn up to a gallon of liquid into sacred blood; a draught sustains a day without food/water and heals 1d6 + Pray (a gallon ~six people). Once/day; undrunk blood sublimates in a minute.
Transubstantiation.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L404

Turn False Life.effect: Commit Effort for the day (Main) vs targets within 60'; roll 2d6 + level of affected undead/automaton/unnatural HD, which save (Mental) or cower for the scene. No effect on foes with twice your HD.
Turn False Life.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L406

Words of Mercy.effect: Commit Effort for the day (Instant) to reroll a failed social check tied to peace, aid, or compassion/mercy/truth; once per check.
Words of Mercy.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L408

Wrath of the Most High.effect: Commit Effort for the scene (Main) to rebuke a visible target; the first time it takes damage before next round ends, it suffers +1d8 + level automatic damage.
Wrath of the Most High.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L410

Open Mind.effect: Commit Effort (On Turn); while Committed, detect a visible living creature's current emotional state as a Main Action (not fine enough to identify the emotion's object unless obvious). (L1 free art.)
Open Mind.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L432

Block Memory.effect: Commit Effort for the day (Main) vs a visible creature and a scene-or-shorter event; Mental save or it forgets and confabulates. Detecting the change is +2 difficulty; restorable.
Block Memory.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L438

Elicitation of Truth.effect: Requires Surface Apprehension. Only on a helpless/cooperative target; Commit Effort for the day and ask a <=2-sentence question; Mental save or it must answer fully without conscious deceit.
Elicitation of Truth.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L440

Facile Speech.effect: Enhances Far Speech: nominate up to six companions as favored targets you link to (On Turn) without Committing Effort, range one mile/level. Change nominees with an hour's meditation.
Facile Speech.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L458

Far Speech.effect: Commit Effort for the scene (On Turn) on a known intelligent creature within 200'/level; with consent, a telepathic link conveys thought/speech/images without a shared language. While linked, both reroll failed Mental saves and can't be surprised unless both are.
Far Speech.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L462

Hypercognition.effect: Eidetic memory and advanced mental calculation; Commit Effort for the day (Instant) to reroll a failed Int-based check. Once per check.
Hypercognition.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L464

Iconograph.effect: Commit Effort for the scene (Main) on a visible text/symbol/artifact to read the maker's intended message; or imbue your own so valid viewers grasp your meaning (audience-restrictable).
Iconograph.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L466

Impress Imperative.effect: Commit Effort for the day (Main) on a visible living creature, giving an overwhelming urge to perform a round-long action not wholly against its nature; Mental save or it obeys next action.
Impress Imperative.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L468

Mind Light.effect: Enhances Open Mind: sense all living minds within 60' (barring barriers/hiding), identify species/strong emotions, recognize known individuals, and never be surprised by a living creature.
Mind Light.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L470

Mind Over Matter.effect: Commit Effort for the day (Instant) for one: auto-stabilize if Mortally Wounded, 24h without sleep, heal 1d6 HP, or ignore climatic extremes for a day.
Mind Over Matter.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L472

Mirror Mask.effect: Sense any mind-affecting power aimed at you and identify a user in range; reroll any Mental save it allows (or get one). On success, Commit Effort for the day (Instant) to feed it false info/feigned success.
Mirror Mask.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L474

Positive Association.effect: Commit Effort for the day (Main) on a visible sentient; Mental save or it treats you as an admired friend and finds your acts reasonable until you/allies harm it or what it loves, or you leave 1+ hour. One target at a time.
Positive Association.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L478

Read Intent.effect: Commit Effort for the scene (Instant) on a visible living creature; Mental save or the GM tells you its next intended action. If you take Total Defense this round, no avoidable attack it makes can hit you.
Read Intent.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L480

Surface Apprehension.effect: Commit Effort for the scene (Main) on a visible living creature; Mental save or you read its surface thoughts this round, and your questions make it instinctively think of brief answers.
Surface Apprehension.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L482

Thoughts Like Razors.effect: Commit Effort for the day (Main) on a visible living creature within 60'; Mental save or 1d8 per Thought Noble level (can KO, not kill). On a save you're stunned, take a quarter damage, lose next turn. Once/scene.
Thoughts Like Razors.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L484

Unthinkable Thought.effect: Commit Effort for the day (Main) on a visible living creature, naming a present person/object/situation; Mental save or it can't consciously acknowledge that subject (unless ignoring risks its life) for up to a scene, with no memory after.
Unthinkable Thought.page: book/Worlds Without Number Deluxe/11 - Arts of the Gyre.md#L486

Accursed Blade.effect: Manifest an occult melee weapon (1d8 one-handed / 2d6 two-handed) adding Magic to damage, Shock 2/15; attacks use Magic and best of Str/Dex/Int/Cha. Usable in or out of armor. (L1 free choice with Accursed Bolt.)
Accursed Blade.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L477

Accursed Bolt.effect: As Accursed Blade but a ranged occult blast: 1d8 + Magic, 200' range, throwable in melee at -4; needs both hands free. (L1 free choice with Accursed Blade.)
Accursed Bolt.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L479

Bewitching Distraction.effect: Out of combat, target an intelligent creature you're talking to; Mental save or it's dazed and forgets you and the scene. Danger ends the daze, not the forgetting.
Bewitching Distraction.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L481

Compelling Shriek.effect: Once/scene, shout a <=7-word command; chosen targets who hear and understand make a Mental save or obey one round, unless wholly against their character.
Compelling Shriek.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L483

Devil's Bargain.effect: Consecrate a deal made with an uncoerced person; if they break it or its spirit you know instantly and may deal 1d6/level to them.
Devil's Bargain.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L485

Dire Pact.effect: Foes take a penalty equal to your Magic skill on saves vs your Accursed arts; if a foe still succeeds, you gain 1 System Strain.
Dire Pact.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L487

Lying Face.effect: While Committed, disguise yourself as any humanoid of similar size, matching clothing, scent, and voice.
Lying Face.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L489

Night-Black Eyes.effect: See in perfect darkness; as a Main Action, focus on a visible object/person/place to learn whether it's enchanted (no detail).
Night-Black Eyes.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L491

Pacted Protection.effect: Choose an energy type; immune to natural amounts and half damage from magical attacks of that type.
Pacted Protection.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L493

Rob Vitality.effect: Once/scene, target a visible foe; Physical save or it loses its next Main Action, which you immediately gain.
Rob Vitality.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L495

Scourging Curse.effect: Curse a visible foe with -1 (-2 at L4, -3 at L9) to hit, damage, and saves for one round/level; one such curse active at a time.
Scourging Curse.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L497

Shadowed Steps.effect: Teleport up to your Move (incl. upward), but not through walls/obstacles.
Shadowed Steps.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L516

Snaring Speech.effect: Once/round, when you fail to persuade/tempt someone, Mental save or they agree if it's something they'd consider. Gain 1 Strain.
Snaring Speech.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L518

Sorcerous Battery.effect: Once/day, you or a visible ally refresh a spell slot used since the prior round's start. Gain 1 Strain.
Sorcerous Battery.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L520

Soul Consumption.effect: When you fell an intelligent target with Accursed Blade/Bolt, it dies instantly; you heal 1d6+level and lose 1 accumulated Strain.
Soul Consumption.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L522

Tendrils of Night.effect: While Committed, eldritch tentacles manipulate objects at your Str up to 20' and melee at range; no bonus actions; arms share your AC and harm to them harms you.
Tendrils of Night.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L524

Unseen Steps.effect: Turn invisible 1d6+level rounds; breaks when you attack, cast, or act violently.
Unseen Steps.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L526

Weight of Sin.effect: Target a visible foe; Physical save or it loses its Move action for 1d6+level rounds.
Weight of Sin.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L528

Weeping Wounds.effect: Once/round, when a visible enemy takes damage, Physical save or 1d6/round for one round/level, unhealable during it. No stack.
Weeping Wounds.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L530

A Thousand Tongues (Bard).effect: Communication arts are understood by all intelligent creatures regardless of language; learn a new language with a week's study with a native speaker. (L1 free art.)
A Thousand Tongues (Bard).page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L602

Battle Cry.effect: Bolster allies: +1 (+2 at L4, +3 at L9) to hit, saves, and damage (incl. Shock) for one round/level.
Battle Cry.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L604

Cursed Tune.effect: Target an intelligent creature: -1 (-2 at L4, -3 at L9) to hit, damage, and saves for one round/level.
Cursed Tune.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L606

Deft Fingers.effect: Your maximum Readied item count increases by two.
Deft Fingers.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L608

Entangle Incantation.effect: When a foe within 60' incants a spell, opposed Int/Magic vs your Cha/Perform +2; tie/win and the spell fizzles. Once/round.
Entangle Incantation.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L610

Evoke Emotion.effect: While performing (not combat, once/scene), evoke an emotion granting you and allies +1 to relevant social checks for the scene; optionally force a new Reaction Roll, keeping it if better.
Evoke Emotion.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L612

Inspire Dread.effect: When enemies make a Morale check, force them to roll twice; any passing both must immediately make an Instinct check.
Inspire Dread.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L616

Keen Senses.effect: Sight-equivalent perception to 60' even if blinded (no color); invisible creatures/objects are obvious to you.
Keen Senses.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L632

Liberating Song.effect: Immune to mind/emotion control; grant an ally a Mental save to throw off such an effect (if it allowed one). A failed second save can't be retried.
Liberating Song.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L634

Rally.effect: Exhort a wounded/fallen ally, removing Frailty and restoring 2d6+level HP; you incur 1 Strain.
Rally.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L636

Soothe the Savage.effect: While you perform each round (Main), animals/bestial creatures won't attack you or allies unless commanded or threatened; can't start once combat has begun.
Soothe the Savage.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L638

Soothing Graces.effect: You and allies lose an extra System Strain after each night's comfortable rest; no stack with similar rest powers.
Soothing Graces.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L640

Swift Misdirection.effect: Tell one creature in earshot a one-sentence claim; unless impossible/unendurable, Mental save or it believes it one round. Once/creature/scene.
Swift Misdirection.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L642

Antimage.effect: Gain one level of the Nullifier Focus free (or a free Focus if you already have both Nullifier levels). (Fixed art, L1.)
Antimage.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L701

Magebane.effect: Add half your level (round up) to all damage you deal to casters by any means. Doesn't stack with Killing Blow. (Fixed art, L1.)
Magebane.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L727

Witchfinder.effect: For the scene, gain Apprehend the Arcane Form's benefits except its dark-vision. (Fixed art, L2.)
Witchfinder.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L735

Spellshield.effect: HP damage from a spell is automatically halved (round down) before saves or resistances. (Fixed art, L2.)
Spellshield.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L731

Disrupt Sorcery.effect: Your next attack that round (even on a miss) leaves the target unable to cast or trigger Mage arts the rest of the round; negated if an ally Screens it. (Fixed art, L3.)
Disrupt Sorcery.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L705

Know Your Prey.effect: Treat Magic skill as one higher (max 4), adding to Effort and possibly above the normal cap. (Fixed art, L4.)
Know Your Prey.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L725

Share the Pain.effect: When targeted by/in the area of a hostile spell, Mental save; success treats the caster as also affected. Once/round. (Fixed art, L5.)
Share the Pain.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L729

Dispel Enchantment.effect: Touch an ally/self to act as Extirpate Arcana; creatures only, once/day per target. (Fixed art, L6.)
Dispel Enchantment.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L703

Ward Ally.effect: When an ally within 30' is affected by a spell, you take it instead (twice if you share the area); your anti-sorcery defenses still apply. (Fixed art, L7.)
Ward Ally.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L733

Immaculate Body.effect: Magical transformations/curses/lingering penalties last at most one scene on you and can't kill you (1 HP min). (Fixed art, L8.)
Immaculate Body.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L707

Immaculate Mind.effect: Immune to unwanted mind-affecting/reading effects; auto see through illusions and magical invisibility. (Fixed art, L9.)
Immaculate Mind.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L723

Absolute Negation.effect: When about to be affected/impeded by an unwanted spell or standing spell-effect, simply ignore the magic. (Fixed art, L10.)
Absolute Negation.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L699

Dread Awe.effect: +1 to intimidation; once/scene (Main) curse foes in battle so those who hear take -1 on their next Morale check.
Dread Awe.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L776

Elite Ties.effect: Readily get audiences with important figures; once/session a favor from them that wouldn't much inconvenience them.
Elite Ties.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L780

Erudite.effect: Once/day, reroll a failed intellectual/scholarly skill check.
Erudite.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L782

Folk-Friend.effect: Once/day, a modest favor from a commoner who doesn't hate you, for a blessing or advice.
Folk-Friend.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L784

Wise Healer.effect: +1 to all Heal checks; once/day auto-succeed a check to stabilize a Mortally Wounded subject. (The Wise art 'Healer'.)
Wise Healer.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L786

Holy Sanctity.effect: +1 to social checks with locals not naturally opposed to your religion or institution.
Holy Sanctity.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L788

Personal Impunity.effect: Harming you is taboo here; only the vicious/desperate start violence on you, and hostile groups hesitate to attack your companions unless provoked.
Personal Impunity.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L790

Skilled.effect: Gain three non-combat skill points (up to your cap). May be taken more than once.
Skilled.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L792

Compel Truth.effect: After a scene-long ordeal, ask one question; GM secretly rolls Cha/Magic vs Morale+1 (level+6 for PCs); success forces a truthful answer. Same question can't be asked twice.
Compel Truth.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L796

Deliver Oracle.effect: A day's ritual on a course; GM secretly rolls Wis/Magic: diff 8 somewhat-true, diff 12 clear, 7- ambiguous, natural 2 misleading.
Deliver Oracle.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L800

Find Object.effect: A scene-long ritual to locate a known object/animal/substance (not people); Wis/Magic vs diff 8-11 by distance (>5 mi undetectable); success gives a direction. Once/day.
Find Object.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L826

Read Omens.effect: A scene-long ritual with 10+ sp sacrifice; Wis/Magic vs diff 10 to judge a course's success/failure; x10 sacrifice = +1. Same course once a month.
Read Omens.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L832

Auspicious Undertaking.effect: Bless a target's current plan; during it they may reroll one failed check or one missed hit. Lasts until used or one day/level. One plan at a time.
Auspicious Undertaking.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L824

Evil Eye.effect: Curse/blessing arts may be used as Instant actions (still one/round) and need only a look, not vocalization.
Evil Eye.page: book/The Atlas of the Latter Earth/04 - Optional Rules and Classes.md#L828

Ill Fate.effect: Curse a visible target; their next relevant check takes -1, and if its raw die is <= your Magic +1 it goes disastrously wrong. Lasts until that check.

Luck Blessing.effect: Bless a visible target so their next skill check that day gets +1; one luck blessing per creature at a time.
